scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/node_modules backend/package-lock.json frontend/node_modules frontend/package-lock.json packages/ui/node_modules packages/ui/package-lock.json packages/api/node_modules packages/api/package-lock.json system-apps/*/node_modules system-apps/*/package-lock.json
scripts.build-apps: cd system-apps && for d in */; do (cd "$d" && npm install && npm run build); done && cd ..
scripts.update-apps: cd system-apps && for d in */; do (cd "$d" && npm update); done && cd ..
